utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you help by sorting donations and keeping an eye on the tool table? I’m running a little late, so that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tool table. Just let me know if you need anything else when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you bring the spare screwdriver and the blue tape, just to be safe?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the spare screwdriver and the blue tape.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I might be a little all over the place, so please let me know if anything runs low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep track and give you a heads-up if anything starts running low.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. Do you know what they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet, but I’d guess they still need people for hauling, sorting, and maybe a few last-minute pickups. If you want, I can check the details so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I can help if they still need someone for pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so, unless I missed an update—has anything changed?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not that I know of—I'm just checking we're still good. Did you hear any change from the team?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming up soon, and folks are already gathering tools and spare parts. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. I can bring over a few tools too if you hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus—I’ll ask around and let you know what’s still missing. Thanks for offering your tools; that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already—if you’re free, you should come by and bring anyone else who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll come by and I’ll see if any neighbors want to help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be wonderful, Opal—thank you. I’ll keep spreading the word so we get a nice turnout.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re definitely in for it? I just want to make sure before I count on you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m definitely in for it. You can count on me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m just waiting on a few more names before we set the final schedule. If you’ve got any leads, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll ask around and send you any names I get.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and circle back once I have enough names to lock in the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep reminding folks. I think we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. Let’s keep it simple and steady so folks know where to be and when.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep telling people the time and place so it stays clear. We’ll make it easy for everyone to show up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve forgotten the details, but I’m happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’m still sorting out the details, but I’ll let you know what would help most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—just give me a shout when you know what’s needed, and I’ll do my best to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a good cause — I can help spread the word around the block. What kind of repairs are you focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the little urgent fixes — leaky faucets, broken steps, and anything that keeps a home safe. We’re trying to get a few neighbors back on solid ground.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense — safety first. I’ll ask around and see who needs a hand or can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I can spread the word to the neighbors right away. If you want, I’ll start inviting people this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great, Quinn. I’ll swing by a bit late and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll start knocking on doors this afternoon and let everyone know. Just text me if you need anything set up before you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. If you need a hand, I can probably help a little.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Let’s keep it simple—if you’re free, meet me by the garage this afternoon and we’ll see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. I’ll meet you by the garage this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to work around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Faye — I was thinking we could start around 3:30, after school lets out. If that doesn’t work, I’m happy to adjust.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 should work for me, thank you. I’ll plan around that and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — just tell folks it’s this Saturday at the community hall and we’re looking for volunteers, tools, and items to fix.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about this Saturday at the community hall and mention you need volunteers, tools, and items to fix.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a few tools for the repair drive—what do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m mostly worried about whether we have enough ladders, extension cords, and tarps—those always seem to go missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and a couple extension cords, and I may have an extra tarp too. I’ll check what I’ve got and set them aside for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let folks know if it moves. Just tell me the spot, and I’ll track it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a huge help. I’ll let you know the spot as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll be ready to note the location as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, what exactly do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need the list of repair items, where they should be dropped off, and whether anything needs to be sorted by priority.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you send me the list of repair items, the drop-off location, and which ones are highest priority?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any spare tools, screws, and a drill if you’ve got one? If you can also help sort the donations when you get here, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll bring what I have and help sort donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing something for the repair drive — do you know what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, probably a few things still, but I’m not sure exactly what’s left. I might’ve missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Same here, I only catch bits second-hand. If you hear any specifics, let me know—I’d like to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening as far as I know. I’ll pass along any updates if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please do let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a lot of support already. I’m happy to spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, thanks. I’m still trying to keep up with everything, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it to folks I run into today. If you need anything specific shared, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, just remind me what needs fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the broken fence panel and the squeaky gate. If you can help with those, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help with the fence panel and the squeaky gate. Just point me to the tools and I’ll get started.
